title: SEC3: Extract complete_delivery/mark_failed common transaction logic
description: In kith-store/src/outbox.rs (lines 214-288), complete_delivery and mark_failed have nearly identical transaction patterns: check kind, DELETE if receipt, else wrap in tx + update message + delete outbox + commit. The UPDATE statement differs (delivery_state='delivered' vs 'failed'). Extract the common transaction scaffolding into a helper to reduce duplication and improve maintainability. Reference: complete_delivery lines 231-246, mark_failed lines 272-284.
